## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture the edge in the SNIPER_VIX_TREND_OOS_CONFIRMED strategy by running a walk-forward analysis across 2025-Q3 and 2026-Q1.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves using the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK strategy with a VIX trend filter. The filter checks if the VIX is above its 5-day average and escalating. The strategy will only enter trades when this condition is met.
